mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 WAA.PROCESSINSTANCEID FROM RAP.APPLICATION A INNER JOIN RAP.WORKFLOW_APP_ASSOC WAA ON WAA.APP_ID = A.ID AND WAA.DELETE_YN = 'N' WHERE A.ID = #{applicationId} ORDER BY WAA.CREATE_DT DESC
SELECT TOP 1 WAA.APP_ID FROM RAP.WORKFLOW_APP_ASSOC WAA WHERE WAA.PROCESSINSTANCEID = #{processInstanceId} AND WAA.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY WAA.CREATE_DT DESC

SELECT TOP 1 WAA.PROCESSINSTANCEID AS PROCESSINSTANCEID, PIL.EXTERNALID AS CONTAINERID, PIL.PROCESSID AS PROCESSID FROM RAP.WORKFLOW_APP_ASSOC WAA INNER JOIN JBPM.PROCESSINSTANCELOG PIL ON PIL.PROCESSINSTANCEID = WAA.PROCESSINSTANCEID WHERE WAA.APP_ID = #{applicationId} AND WAA.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY WAA.CREATE_DT DESC
